title: 🚨 YOU’RE NOT RAISING “GOOD KIDS”… YOU’RE RAISING FUTURE DISCIPLES OR FUTURE DRIFTERS.
paragraphs: 🚨 YOU’RE NOT RAISING “GOOD KIDS”… YOU’RE RAISING FUTURE DISCIPLES OR FUTURE DRIFTERS.
Let that sink in.
Every day your children are being shaped.

Not just by school.
Not just by friends.
Not just by screens.
But by what happens… or doesn’t happen… inside your home.
And here’s the hard truth:

Most Christian parents hope their kids will follow God…
…but very few are intentionally discipling them.
⚠️ That’s the gap this book confronts.
This is not another parenting theory.
This is a simple, biblical, repeatable system that turns your home into a place where your children actually learn to walk with God.

No overwhelm.
No long sermons.
No complicated plans.
Just daily, intentional discipleship that works.
🔥 WHAT YOU’LL GAIN INSIDE:

• A 5-step daily system (Read. Talk. Pray. Practice. Repeat.)
• How to disciple your kids in 5–10 minutes a day
• Simple ways to turn meals, mornings, and bedtime into spiritual moments
• How to correct your child without just punishing behavior
• How to teach your kids repentance, prayer, and obedience
• A weekly family rhythm that builds real faith—not just religion
⚔️ REALITY CHECK

Most people raise children who behave in public.
Few people raise children who follow Jesus in private.

Most people rely on church once a week.
Few people build daily discipleship at home.

Most people hope their kids “turn out okay.”
Few people train them in the Word of God.
Which one are you becoming?
This is NOT a public release.

• Strengthen your family spiritually
• Build discipline and consistency
• Break passive, distracted Christianity
• Raise believers who actually live the Word
💥 New resources added consistently
This is for serious believers only.
If you’re done leaving your children’s faith to chance…
If you’re ready to lead your home with intention…
If you refuse to raise spiritually passive kids—

Become the parent who doesn’t just provide…
but disciples.
💬 ENGAGE WITH THIS POST
This is bigger than a book.
This is a movement of families returning to God.
